q20. Server-Sent Events (SSE); hub: `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`; handlers: `CreateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`, `CreateMemoComment`, `UpsertMemoReaction`, `DeleteMemoReaction`

The mechanism is Server-Sent Events, implemented via the `SSEHub` type/methods in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`.

Memo-related handlers that broadcast through `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)`:

- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 163)
- `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 585)
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (line 126)
- `APIV1Service.UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (line 106)
- `APIV1Service.DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (line 161)

Additionally, `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go`), `APIV1Service.SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go`), and `APIV1Service.SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go`) all broadcast indirectly by calling the shared helper `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` (line 71), which itself calls `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)`.
